description.content:
This endpoint generates an access token that will be used with your Public Api call's. The generated token will be placed in the `Authorization` header with value: `"Bearer YOUR_GENERATED_TOKEN"`

> The credentials used in the body must be generated from the Agicap application.

urlencoded.description: (Required) The grant type as defined in the OAuth2 specification (must be client_credentials, authorization_code is not yet supported).
(Required) The client identifier generated through the Agicap application.
(Required) The client secret generated through the Agicap application.
(Required) The scopes list separated by whitespace (should at least contains "agicap:public-api").
